description: 中文口语 → 技能主题/关键词 映射层（只读查表，不过路由逻辑）

entries.evidence: community-raw/hack-skills/container-escape-techniques/SKILL.md: 'escape to the host via privileged mode, capabilities, Docker socket, cgroup abuse'；sandbox-escape-techniques/SKILL.md: 'breaking out of Python sandbox, Lua sandbox, seccomp filter, chroot jail, container/Docker'；hack-diag REPORT D28：口语'逃出去'≠别名'逃逸'致零候选。
community-raw/hack-skills/ios-pentesting-tricks/SKILL.md: 'testing iOS applications … runtime manipulation, binary protection analysis'；hack-diag R21：口语'苹果端'，别名只收ios/iphone致miss。
community-raw/hack-skills/kubernetes-pentesting/SKILL.md: 'targeting Kubernetes clusters via API server, RBAC enumeration, service account abuse … pod escape'；hack-diag D27/R24：'集群'未映射k8s。
community-raw/hack-skills/race-condition/SKILL.md: 'testing one-time operations, concurrent HTTP abuse … CWE-362-style synchronization gaps'；hack-diag D22：'并发'未映射'条件竞争'（多领券即one-time operations口语版）。
skills/pentest-tools/SKILL.md 触发关键词含'安全评估、风险评估'；R11 keywords含'安全评估|security assess|风险评估|risk assess'。'效果掉了'是评估类任务的口语现象说法。
community-raw/hack-skills/xss-cross-site-scripting/SKILL.md: 'user-controlled content reaches HTML, attributes, JavaScript, DOM sinks'；hack-diag D03：'弹窗/尖括号'≠'跨站'系唯一桥。
community-raw/hack-skills/cors-cross-origin-misconfiguration/（R46 must含cors misconfig）；hack-diag D37：'跨域'≠'跨域资源共享'致wrapper对引用错。
community-raw/hack-skills/sqli-sql-injection/SKILL.md: 'DB-specific blind and out-of-band execution paths'（blind即延时口语的技术本体）；hack-diag D01/D02：加引号报错/延时变慢零映射。
hack-diag REPORT D08/D15/D36：用户用'改/看/进'等动词带出行为（改路径读文件、改数字看订单、换方法进），零正式名词。本层只做弱信号，需与领域名词共现才生效。
entries.topic: VERB-ONLY: get in / open (needs domain noun)

entries.evidence: skills/attack-chain/SKILL.md含'拿下核心'多阶段拿下语境；skills/pentest-tools/SKILL.md 渗透测试语境。'破/拿下'为攻破类口语动词，需领域名词共现。
entries.topic: VERB-ONLY: crack / take over (needs domain noun)

entries.evidence: R41 must含'做题|刷题|解题'；ctf-apk-diag C03'周末想找点题刷刷'、C08'一起头脑风暴'为练手/体验类口语；skills/ctf-sandbox/SKILL.md: 'Use when the user says CTF, AWD, 靶场, or 比赛题'。
entries.topic: VERB-ONLY: try hands-on / practice (needs domain noun)

entries.evidence: routing.json R2 keywords含'闪退|应用防护|加了啥防护'且mustAll约束移动端语境；ctf-apk-diag A06：模拟器打开应用直接闪退（模拟器检测零覆盖）。
routing.json R9 keywords含'一跑就连外网|连外网删自己'；skills/malware-analysis/SKILL.md: 'behavioral techniques, including IOC extraction … sandboxing'。
R49 must含'anti-tamper|反篡改|重签名'；R6 must含'授权校验|注册校验'（需二进制语境）；ctf-apk-diag A05重打包签名不一致改判命中R49。
routing.json R25 keywords含'往外传东西|往外传数据'（取证语境）；skills/malware-analysis/SKILL.md行为分析+IOC提取；R2含'通信加密'移动端语境。
routing.json R2 keywords含'抓不到包|防抓包'；ctf-apk-diag A03/A12：ssl pinning/证书绑定致抓包失败，R1词表只认certificate pinning。
community-raw/hack-skills/linux-privilege-escalation/SKILL.md: 'when you have low-privilege shell access and need to escalate to root'；hack-diag D33唯一matched：英文linux+shell+提权三料齐。
routing.json R24 keywords含'票据冒充|伪造|拿票据|黄金票据|白银票据'；hack-diag D31：'票据'别名立功（修复有效的极少数证据）；record源skills/active-directory-kerberos-attacks。

community-raw/hack-skills/ssti-server-side-template-injection/SKILL.md: 'template expressions, server-side rendering, preview features … may evaluate attacker-controlled content'；hack-diag D05：'模板'≠'模板注入'差两字。
community-raw/hack-skills/memory-forensics-volatility/SKILL.md（volatility取证）；routing.json R25含'volatility|内存转储|内存dump'；hack-diag D35'内存镜像'别名立功首位命中；ctf-apk-diag C23 volatility。

community-raw/hack-skills/idor-broken-object-authorization/SKILL.md: 'requests expose object identifiers … missing object-level authorization checks'；ctf-apk-diag C24 burp见token拼url疑越权；R12 must含'看别人的订单|改id看'。
record源skills/authbypass-authentication-flaws；hack-diag D17找回密码/重置/验证码零映射、D20爆破/枚举/验证码零映射。
entries.topic: auth bypass / password reset / captcha reuse

entries.evidence: community-raw/hack-skills/jwt-oauth-token-attacks/（D18裸'令牌'未收，只收令牌伪造/篡改）；R12 must含'token伪造|伪造成token'。
R46 must含'request smuggling'；hack-diag D21：描述精准但无'请求走私'四字即死。
community-raw/hack-skills/upload-insecure-files/SKILL.md: 'testing upload validation, storage paths, processing pipelines, preview behavior'；hack-diag D09/D10：口语后缀/文件头触发不了（中文canonical冻结）。
community-raw/hack-skills/path-traversal-lfi/SKILL.md: 'file paths, download endpoints … may expose filesystem control'；hack-diag D08：改路径读敏感文件零映射。
community-raw/hack-skills/ssrf-server-side-request-forgery/SKILL.md: 'server fetches URLs … toward internal networks, cloud metadata'；hack-diag D13/D14：口语'预览图/云特殊地址'零映射。

community-raw/hack-skills/deserialization-insecure/SKILL.md: 'Java, PHP, or Python applications deserialize untrusted data via ObjectInputStream, unserialize, pickle'；hack-diag D24唯一双路命中靠'反序列化'、D11 java类名被埋。
community-raw/hack-skills/csrf-cross-site-request-forgery/SKILL.md: 'state-changing web flows, anti-CSRF defenses … login CSRF'；hack-diag D38：csrf零中文别名，口语'点链接替发请求'。
record源skills/401-403-bypass-techniques；hack-diag D36/R01：403/绕过/后缀/换方法零映射；hitrate-hack HINTS中文'后台页面一直提示没有权限进不去'为同义新写（非复制）。

routing.json R9 must含'附件exe'样本语境；skills/malware-analysis/SKILL.md: 'analyzing suspected malware … sandboxing, and anti-analysis behavior'；skills/email-security/SKILL.md: 'phishing analysis'。第三方投递物多为样本/钓鱼载体。

note: 目标解析：R+数字=routing.json路由；community-*=registry.json记录；其余=source_path基名或canonical技能目录。动词层（nl-verb-*）与场景层（nl-scene-*）为弱信号，接入时必须要求领域名词共现或仅作no_match回退。
